name: Adam Forman
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: I offer inclusive, compassionate, and down-to-earth counselling for individuals, couples, and diverse relationship configurations, both online and in-person from my space in Fitzroy North. My practice is grounded in authenticity and care, creating a space where people can explore their lives without fear of judgment. I work with people of all genders, sexualities, and backgrounds, and I am committed to creating a safe and inclusive space for all.

name: Adham Hammoud
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: My name is Adham Hammoud and I am a Registered Counsellor (Level 3) and Accredited Mental Health Social Worker. I have over 15 years of experience in health care, hospitals, mental health, crisis services, trauma services and private practice. My main modalities are CBT, ACT, DBT and EMDR.

name: Aimee Masson
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Psyche Soma Medicine, is a holistic health & wellness studio in Northcote, Melbourne. Offering integrative psychotherapy, shiatsu based body work, trauma informed yoga & energetic healing. Our focus is to help clients tune into their own authentic self-expression & personal power, through creative and collaborative therapeutic techniques.

name: Alfonso Pavon
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Integrative Counselling supports overthinkers, high achievers, and LGBTQIA+ people navigating anxiety, burnout, and recurring relationship patterns. Sessions combine talk therapy with nervous system regulation, using evidence-based somatic, attachment-focused, and trauma-informed approaches to help you feel calmer, more grounded, and more connected in your life and relationships. I offer individual counselling in English and Spanish, online and in person in Melbourne, with flexible appointments and a collaborative, culturally affirming approach tailored to your needs.

name: Amanda Egan
title: Counsellor (ACA Provisional)
description: I’m Amanda Egan, and I am excited to be a dedicated counsellor at Karinya Farm. My role here is to support individuals on their journey toward personal growth and well-being by providing a warm, professional and empathetic environment where clients can explore their challenges and achieve their goals. If you are navigating life transitions, seeking emotional support, or striving for personal development, I am here to help.
